problem: When Aiden runtime timed out, the browser removed the pending owner message and the server timeout payload only returned an Aiden notice, making the owner input appear deleted.
implemented: Server watchdog timeout/error payloads now include a preserved owner message packet before the Aiden runtime notice.
Browser runtime-failure handling now preserves owner input if a timeout/error payload lacks an owner echo.
Browser network/abort failures now mark the pending owner message as locally preserved instead of deleting it.
Default server runtime timeout increased from 45 seconds to 120 seconds for live public-read workloads.
Browser request timeout increased from 60 seconds to 150 seconds.
owner_visible_change: The owner input remains visible even when Aiden times out. The owner sees both the preserved input and the runtime notice.
limitations: This does not make slow strategy/live-public-read runs faster.
A watchdog notice may still occur if the runtime exceeds the configured timeout.
